photoAltZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔 16 号法拉利 SF90 的 1:24 模型
collectionReason: Charles Leclerc is my favourite driver. I collected the SF90 because it’s the car he drove to his first Formula 1 win, at Spa, and to his first win at Ferrari’s home race, at Monza. Both came in his first season with Ferrari, which makes this model special to me.
collectionReasonZh: 勒克莱尔是我最喜欢的车手。我收藏这辆 SF90，是因为他开着它在斯帕拿到了 F1 生涯首胜，随后又在蒙扎首次赢下法拉利的主场比赛。这两场胜利都发生在他加盟法拉利的第一年，所以这辆模型对我很有纪念意义。
seasonSummary: In his first season with Scuderia Ferrari, Leclerc earned his maiden F1 win at the Belgian Grand Prix on 1 September and won again at Monza on 8 September, Ferrari’s first home victory since 2010. He finished fourth in the drivers’ championship with 264 points, two wins, seven poles and ten podiums. Ferrari took second in the constructors’ championship with 504 points.
seasonSummaryZh: 2019 年是勒克莱尔效力法拉利的首个赛季。9 月 1 日，他在斯帕举行的比利时大奖赛拿下 F1 生涯首胜。9 月 8 日，他又在蒙扎赢得意大利大奖赛，为法拉利带来自 2010 年以来的首场主场胜利。他以 264 分位列车手积分榜第四，全年收获 2 胜、7 个杆位和 10 次领奖台。法拉利以 504 分获车队亚军。

collectionReasonZh: 这是我的第一台 1:24 F1 车模。我最喜欢的车手是勒克莱尔，也很喜欢法拉利在蒙扎主场用的红黄特别涂装，所以选了这一辆。
seasonSummary: Ferrari added Modena yellow to the F1-75 for the 2022 Italian Grand Prix, marking 75 years since its first car. At Monza, Leclerc took pole and finished second. He ended the season second in the drivers’ standings with 308 points, three wins, nine poles and 11 podiums.
seasonSummaryZh: 2022 年意大利大奖赛，法拉利在 F1-75 上加入了摩德纳黄，纪念首辆法拉利问世 75 周年。勒克莱尔在蒙扎拿到杆位，正赛获得第二。他全年收获 3 胜、9 个杆位和 11 次领奖台，以 308 分获得车手亚军。

collectionReason: The special helmet in the cockpit is what makes this model stand out for me. It reminds me of when Leclerc finally won his home Grand Prix, becoming the first Monegasque driver to win it in the Formula 1 World Championship era.
collectionReasonZh: 这台车最吸引我的细节是驾驶舱里的摩纳哥站特别版头盔。它让我想起勒克莱尔第一次在家乡夺冠，也成为 F1 世界锦标赛历史上首位赢得摩纳哥大奖赛的本土车手。
seasonSummary: Leclerc won from pole in Monaco on 26 May 2024. He was the first Monegasque winner there in the F1 World Championship era and the first since Louis Chiron won the pre-championship race in 1931. He also won at Monza and in Austin, finishing third in the 2024 drivers’ standings with 356 points.
seasonSummaryZh: 2024 年 5 月 26 日，勒克莱尔从杆位出发，赢得摩纳哥大奖赛。他是 F1 世界锦标赛创立以来首位在这里夺冠的摩纳哥车手，也是继 1931 年路易·希龙之后首位夺冠的本土车手。该赛季他还赢了蒙扎和奥斯汀两站，以 356 分排名车手积分榜第三。

seasonSummary: Leclerc finished 13th on his Formula 1 debut in Australia on 25 March 2018. In his fourth race, at Baku on 29 April, he finished sixth and earned his first eight championship points. He finished his rookie season 13th overall with 39 points.

collectionReason: Two details make this car stand out in my collection: Leclerc won at Silverstone in the SF-26, and Ferrari’s rotating rear wing was one of the designs that caught my eye when the 2026 rules changed.
collectionReasonZh: 这台车有两个地方让我印象很深。一是勒克莱尔开着 SF-26 在银石夺冠，二是 2026 年规则大改后，法拉利拿出了很吸引我注意的翻转式尾翼。
seasonSummary: The SF-26 was Scuderia Ferrari HP’s entry under the 2026 rules, which introduced active front and rear wings. Ferrari trialled a rear-wing flap that rotates upside down in straight-line mode, then raced it in Miami. Red Bull and McLaren also developed their own rotating-wing solutions. On 5 July, Leclerc won the British Grand Prix at Silverstone in the No. 16 car, ahead of George Russell and Lewis Hamilton.
seasonSummaryZh: SF-26 是法拉利车队为 2026 年新规打造的赛车。新规引入可主动调节的前翼和尾翼。法拉利试验了能在直道模式下翻转的尾翼翼片，并在迈阿密赛事中使用。红牛与迈凯伦也分别研发了各自的旋转翼方案。7 月 5 日，勒克莱尔驾驶 16 号车在银石赢得英国大奖赛，领先乔治·拉塞尔与刘易斯·汉密尔顿。

Ocon finished 18th in the No. 31 car, while teammate Oliver Bearman finished tenth in the No. 87 car with the same livery. collectionReason: I collected the RB19 because winning 21 out of 22 Grands Prix is an extraordinary record. That level of dominance is what makes the car stand out to me.

seasonSummary: The RB19 won 21 of 22 Grands Prix in 2023. Verstappen won 19 and Sergio Pérez won two. The only race Red Bull did not win was Singapore, where Ferrari’s Carlos Sainz took victory. Verstappen ended the season with 575 points and his third drivers’ title.
seasonSummaryZh: RB19 在 2023 年 22 场大奖赛正赛中赢下 21 场，其中维斯塔潘赢了 19 场，塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹赢了 2 场。剩下的一场是新加坡站，冠军是法拉利车手卡洛斯·塞恩斯。维斯塔潘最终以 575 分赢得个人第三个车手冠军。

collectionReason: I collected the Suzuka RB21 because I love its white-and-red Honda tribute livery, and because Verstappen won the race in it. The design feels like a fitting farewell to Red Bull’s partnership with Honda.
collectionReasonZh: 我收藏铃鹿版 RB21，一是因为我很喜欢这套红白致敬涂装，二是因为维斯塔潘开着它赢下了那场比赛。我觉得用这套设计告别红牛和本田多年的合作很有纪念意义。
seasonSummary: Red Bull ran the white-and-red RB21 at Suzuka in the final season of its Honda partnership. The livery recalled the RA272, which gave Honda its first Formula 1 win in Mexico in 1965. Verstappen won from pole on 6 April 2025, his fourth consecutive Japanese Grand Prix victory. Red Bull partnered with Ford for the new power-unit era in 2026.
seasonSummaryZh: 2025 年是红牛与本田合作的最后一个赛季。铃鹿站的红白涂装致敬了 RA272，它曾在 1965 年墨西哥站为本田赢得 F1 首胜。2025 年 4 月 6 日，维斯塔潘从杆位出发夺冠，连续第四次赢下日本大奖赛。进入 2026 年新动力单元时代后，红牛转而与福特合作。

collectionReason: I collected the MCL39 because it’s the car in which Norris won his first world title. To me it also marks the end of the 2022–25 ground-effect rules, which gives the model an extra reason to keep.

seasonSummary: Norris won seven races and took 18 podiums and seven poles in 2025. Third place in Abu Dhabi secured his first world drivers’ title with 423 points, two ahead of Max Verstappen. The championship closed the 2022–25 regulation cycle before Formula 1 introduced its new cars in 2026.
seasonSummaryZh: 2025 年，诺里斯拿下 7 胜、18 次领奖台和 7 个杆位。他在阿布扎比以第三名完赛，最终拿到 423 分，以 2 分优势领先维斯塔潘，赢得个人首个车手世界冠军。这个赛季是 2022–2025 年规则周期的最后一年，F1 在 2026 年迎来新一代赛车。

photoAlt: HappyCar 1:64 Mercedes-AMG GT Black Series F1 Safety Car in the red 500 Grand Prix anniversary livery
photoAltZh: HappyCar 1:64 梅赛德斯-AMG GT Black Series F1 安全车模型，红色 500 场大奖赛纪念涂装
seasonSummary: This miniature depicts the 500 Grand Prix anniversary livery from Austin in October 2025, marking 500 Grands Prix supplied by Mercedes-AMG since 1996. The GT Black Series served from 2022 through July 2026, with its last deployment at Spa. The GT 63 PRO 4MATIC+ took over at the Hungarian Grand Prix. German driver Bernd Mayländer has driven the FIA Formula 1 Safety Car since 2000. Race Control sends it out when an incident or dangerous conditions require the race to be neutralised. It leads the field at a controlled speed, with overtaking generally prohibited, while marshals clear the hazard. The photographs show the same safety-car model at Suzuka and Shanghai. Mercedes’ Austin gallery shows the exact anniversary livery on the miniature.
seasonSummaryZh: 模型还原的是 2025 年 10 月奥斯汀站的「500 场大奖赛」纪念涂装，纪念梅赛德斯-AMG 自 1996 年以来第 500 次为大奖赛提供安全车。GT Black Series 从 2022 年服役至 2026 年 7 月，最后一次出动是在斯帕。GT 63 PRO 4MATIC+ 从匈牙利站接替它。德国车手贝恩德·梅兰德自 2000 年起驾驶 F1 官方安全车。出现事故或危险状况时，赛事控制中心会派出安全车，让赛车以受控速度跟随，通常禁止超车，让赛道工作人员处理险情。两张照片拍的是同款安全车在铃鹿和上海的实车，模型对应的纪念涂装可在梅赛德斯的奥斯汀图集中查看。
